body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> OnStar demonstrated its mobile application at CES 2010, which allows iPhone, Droid, and Blackberry Storm owners to connect remotely to their Chevrolet Volt electric vehicles.

The application help users see information such as charge levels, basic vehicle information, and even start the vehicle remotely. The OnStar mobile application will be available for Volt owners at launch, and production for the Volt is scheduled to begin in late 2010.
